# 4.5.4 part B: the release pull request made by one command – Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax.

**Goal:** `npm run release -- prepare 4.5.4 --name="Simple release"` makes the release branch, every generated file,
the skeletons of what needs prose, and opens the pull request; `npm run release -- check 4.5.4` says what is still
missing before it can be merged.

**Architecture:** a new `tools/release/prepare.mjs` holds pure helpers (each tested) and the orchestration, which
runs the commands that already exist in the right order. `tools/changes.ts` learns the two things done by hand for
4.5.3. The golden-save list leaves `tests/save-v3.test.ts`. `npm run release` is a new script whose first verbs are
`prepare` and `check` (part D adds the release itself).

**Tech Stack:** Node ESM (`.mjs`, like the other release tools), tsx for the TypeScript tools it calls, Vitest.

**Spec:** `docs/dev/PLAN-4.5.4-SIMPLE-RELEASE.md` part B (S5, S6). Facts: the mapping of 4.5.3's release commit
`2afb9f51`, file by file (in the session record; summarised in each task).

## Global Constraints
- Every file `prepare` writes is what the release commit of 4.5.3 (`2afb9f51`) wrote, by the same tools, in this order:
  version → CHANGELOG/LOG → wiki skeletons → transition pages → golden save → reference run → passes → README line →
  quality baseline last.
- Prose is never invented: each part that needs it is a skeleton with the marker `TODO(release)`, and `release -- check`
  fails while one is left.
- `prepare` refuses: a version that is not `x.y.z` greater than package.json's; a dirty checkout; a branch other than an
  up-to-date `main`; a shallow clone; a new minor (no `install.upgrade-notes-<x>-<y>.md` page yet: said, not created).
- `--no-pr` stops after the commit (nothing pushed). The pull request goes to the organisation's repository from the
  remote `releaseRemote()` does not name (the fork), like every PR of this project.
- Shell and repo rules as in part A's plans. Translation pairs are recorded `--kind ai --relation author` by the
  agent or person who writes the prose, never by `prepare`.

## Review Focus
1. Run twice: the second run refuses (branch exists / version not greater), never doubles a CHANGELOG section.
2. A `.log.md` without `.md` (4.5.3 had two): folded at its place, then deleted.
3. No `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md: created, not an error.
4. The golden save is written with cwd = the repository root (its paths are relative).
5. `release -- check` on today's main (4.5.3 released): passes for 4.5.3, fails for 4.5.4 with the missing items listed.

---

### Task 3: the pure helpers of `prepare`
**Files:** create `tools/release/prepare.mjs`, `tests/release-prepare.test.ts`.
- Produces (exported, pure, tested):
  - `nextVersionProblem(current, next)` → `undefined` or why (`x.y.z`, greater, same minor for a patch page).
  - `releaseHeading(version, date)` → `## 4.5.4 — 2026-10-26`; `changelogIntro(version, name, logRange)` → the `LOG #a–#b: "<name>", a patch on <prev>. TODO(release): …` skeleton paragraph.
  - `logReleaseEntry(n, date, version, name)` → the `## #n · <date> · Claude · release · <v> "<name>": TODO(release)` entry with 4.5.3's fixed bullets (The request, What ships, Fragments, Upgrade notes, Reviews, Fixtures, Passes, Signature) and `→ next:`.
  - `upgradeNotesSection(prev, version, name, lang, bullets)` → the `<a name="from-…">`, `<!-- applies: <v>.. -->`, heading (en / fr wording of the 4.5.3 section), "Nothing to change in a game: TODO(release)" opener, the assembled bullets as a starting list; and `upgradeNotesLead(lead, version)` adding the version to the lead's list.
  - `passesSheet(previousSheet, prev, version)` → the previous sheet with its heading and intro's version and `field:init` line rewritten, the table unchanged.
  - `withPassIssues(contracts, prev, version)` → `passIssues` with `"<v>"` added to every pass that has `"<prev>"`.
  - `currentReleaseLine(lang, version, name)` → `Current release: [v<v> (<name>)](…/releases/tag/v<v>): TODO(release)` / `Release actuelle : …`.
  - `todoMarkers(files)` → the `file:line` of every `TODO(release)` left.
- [ ] Tests first, from 4.5.3's real files as fixtures (`git show 2afb9f51:<file>` read in the test, compared section by section): each helper turns the 4.5.2 version of a file into the 4.5.3 one, prose aside. Run: FAIL. Implement. Run: PASS. Commit.

### Task 4: `npm run release -- prepare` and `-- check`
**Files:** `tools/release/prepare.mjs` (the `main`), `package.json` (`"release": "node tools/release/prepare.mjs"` – part D will route `release <v>` to the release itself), `tests/release-prepare.test.ts`.
- `prepare <v> --name="<n>" [--date=YYYY-MM-DD] [--no-pr] [--dry-run]`: the refusals of the Global Constraints, then `git switch -c release/<v>`, then each step with a `say()` line; the commands run with `cwd` = the repository root: `npm version <v> --no-git-tag-version`; the helpers' edits around `npm run changes -- --assemble --date=<d>`; `npm run wiki -- transition`; `npx tsx tools/golden-save.ts <v>` + `index.json`; `GAME=reference npx tsx tools/speedrun/reference-run.ts`; passes sheet + passIssues; README lines; `npm run quality:baseline`; `git add -A`, one commit `<v>: the release (prepared)`; unless `--no-pr`: push to the fork remote, `gh pr create` with a body listing the `TODO(release)` left and the commands for the prose's translation records. `--dry-run` prints the steps, writes nothing.
- `check <v>`: CHANGELOG section present (via `scripts/release-notes.mjs`), no `TODO(release)`, `npm run wiki -- check` without warnings, `quality:baseline -- --check`; prints each item ✔/✖ and exits 1 on any ✖.
- [ ] Tests: `--dry-run` lists the steps in the order of the Global Constraints; the refusals (bad version, dirty, not on main) exit 1 with their reason before any write (run in a temporary clone of the repo made in the test: `git clone --local`); `check 4.5.3` passes on the checkout, `check 4.5.4` fails listing the CHANGELOG section. Run: FAIL. Implement. Run: PASS. Commit.
- [ ] A real dry run: `npm run release -- prepare 4.5.4 --name="Simple release" --dry-run` on main – read its output.

### Task 5: docs, fragments, PR
- `wiki/en|fr/contribute.releasing.md`: a "Prepare the release pull request" section (the command, what it writes, what is left to write, `release -- check`); `reference.npm-scripts` (the `release` script, via `wiki/data/npm-scripts.json` + generate); fragments `changes/454-release-prepare.md` and `.log.md`. Checks: wiki check, quality, baseline, changes check, the related tests, the full suite. Review of the branch by a fresh reviewer, then the PR.
